topic.title: Biodiversity Net Gain / Statutory Metric / Habitat Management and Monitoring
topic.source_contract: development identity, applicable statutory regime, baseline date, habitat survey, condition assessment, statutory metric version, pre- and post-development units, trading rules, spatial risk, onsite and offsite gains, legal security, gain plan approval, habitat management and monitoring plan, implementation and 30-year monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A habitat map is not a completed statutory metric.
A metric calculation is not an approved Biodiversity Gain Plan.
Proposed habitat creation is not delivered biodiversity gain.
An offsite proposal is not a registered allocation.
Planning permission is not discharge of the biodiversity gain condition.
A legal agreement is not evidence of habitat condition achievement.
Monitoring commitments are not measured 30-year outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact metric, plan approval, legal security, implementation and monitoring evidence.
